Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. The effect is a blooming cloud of stardust that flashes bright enough to blind, spreading across the whole width. Frame 1 fine glitter draws inward into a dense compact seed. Frames 2-4 it blooms outward as a wide soft cloud of drifting motes with long lens-flare needles. Frame 6 the cloud flashes at its brightest with a broad white veil and radiating spikes. Frames 7-8 the veil dims and the motes scatter and drift down. Palette: violet and indigo night, pale starlight gold, frosted glass and cold metal, restrained white sparkle.
